info.title: Get Reject Reasons
info.description: Use this API to retrieve the seller reject-reason options currently applicable to the specified aftersales request. Use the returned name value as the reject reason key when calling the corresponding seller reject API.

get.description: Use this API to retrieve the seller reject-reason options currently applicable to the specified aftersales request. Use the returned name value as the reject reason key when calling the corresponding seller reject API.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description:
The BCP-47 locale codes for displaying the rejection reason, delimited by commas. Default: en-US
Refer to [Locale codes](678e3a47bae28f030a8c7523) for the list of supported locale codes.

parameters.name: return_or_cancel_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier for an order return or cancellation.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

name.description: The reject reason key. Pass this exact value to the corresponding seller reject API as the reject reason. Note: The available reject reasons may change depending on the current aftersales request context. To avoid using stale or inapplicable reason keys, call this API close to the reject action and use the latest returned name values instead of hardcoding them.

text.description: The corresponding text to the reason name, localized based on the locale input parameter.
text.example: You have reached an agreement with the buyer

reasons.description: The list of rejection reasons the seller has provided.
